title: AgentLogs: A Dataset for Opening the Black Box of GitHub's Cloud Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.29204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI-based software engineering agents are becoming routine contributors to real-world software projects. On GitHub, developers can assign tasks to the Copilot cloud agent, which autonomously explores the repository, edits code, runs commands, and opens or reviews pull requests, producing a detailed log of every step along the way. While existing datasets capture outcomes of agent contributions, such as agent-authored pull requests, the process by which agents produce these contributions remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AgentLogs, a large-scale dataset of agent activity on GitHub. AgentLogs comprises 307,416 agent tasks and 549,239 agent sessions in 35,810 of the 1,812,362 popular public repositories that we scanned, together with 64,255,174 session log entries that record each agent run step by step, including prompts, intermediate reasoning, tool calls (e.g., file edits, git operations, and GitHu

translated_title: AgentLogs：一个揭开GitHub云端智能体黑盒的数据集
translated_abstract: 基于生成式AI的软件工程智能体正日益成为真实世界软件项目的常规贡献者。在GitHub上，开发者可以将任务分配给Copilot云智能体，该智能体能够自主探索代码仓库、编辑代码、运行命令、创建或审查拉取请求，并生成记录每一步操作的详细日志。尽管现有数据集捕捉了智能体贡献的结果（例如智能体编写的拉取请求），但智能体产生这些贡献的过程在很大程度上仍未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们推出了AgentLogs，一个大规模的GitHub智能体活动数据集。AgentLogs包含307,416个智能体任务和549,239个智能体会话，覆盖我们扫描的1,812,362个热门公开仓库中的35,810个，并附带64,255,174条会话日志条目，逐条记录每次智能体运行的完整过程，包括提示词、中间推理、工具调用（例如文件编辑、git操作和GitHub API调用等）。
tldr: 该论文发布了AgentLogs——首个大规模GitHub智能体活动数据集，包含30余万个任务、54万余个会话及6400多万条逐步日志，首次打开了GitHub Copilot云智能体完成软件工程任务全过程的“黑盒”。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentLogs, a large-scale dataset of 307K+ agent tasks, 549K+ agent sessions, and 64M+ step-by-step log entries that opens the black box of how GitHub's Copilot cloud agent autonomously performs software engineering tasks.
